chapters.label: The run, live
chapters.text: Wembley, August 2025. Liverpool play Crystal Palace. Jeremie Frimpong races down the right wing. He skips past Tyrick Mitchell, into the box... and his chip floats in!

chapters.label: The rocket run
chapters.text: Watch again. Szoboszlai slips it to him and he flies. One quick jink inside, and the defender is left behind.

chapters.label: Cross or shot?
chapters.text: Then he lifts it over Dean Henderson. Was it a cross or a shot? It hits the far post and drops in!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: Your turn! Use your speed to get past the defender. Then look up before you cross, and pick your target.
